verdict.rationale: Attio's Workflows product page markets a first-party Routing Agent that "routes every lead to the right rep or channel." It also shows an example workflow that fires when a new deal is created and uses an agent to "route to the right AE," all built in a visual automation builder. The evidence is marketing-level only, with no documentation of how routing logic, owner assignment or balancing is configured. missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, explicit round-robin or load-balanced distribution, docs on how the owner attribute is set, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin
